summary: First iteration end-to-end test of the Italian team job management app. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass (auth login/logout/register/me, stats, work-types CRUD + RBAC, team CRUD + RBAC, jobs full CRUD + status patch + complete/restore, invalid status). Frontend: all critical flows verified via Playwright - admin login, dashboard shows Fatturato 3100,00 €, table lists 3 active jobs, search filter works, job creation via modal succeeds, mark-completed archives, Completati tab shows archived job, restore works, admin sees Impostazioni tab with type/member inputs, theme toggle switches to dark, logout redirects to /login and clears session, wrong password shows error, member (giulia.bianchi) does NOT see settings tab. Backend correctly returns 403 for member on POST /api/work-types and POST /api/team.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has a minor issue: seed_data() member seed check uses count of role=member users; if an admin manually deletes all members, re-seed on startup will recreate defaults. This is likely desired but worth documenting.
Login lockout uses IP:email identifier and locks for 15 min after 5 failed attempts - working but might affect legitimate test/dev cycles. Consider a debug reset endpoint or shorter window in dev.
CORS middleware is added after include_router; in FastAPI order does not strictly matter for CORS but best practice is to add middleware before routes for clarity.
No pagination on GET /api/jobs (limit 1000) and GET /api/team (limit 100) - acceptable for MVP scale.

seed_data_creation: Seed already handled by backend startup (3 active jobs, 2 archived = 3100€, 5 work types, 1 admin + 3 members). Tests created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers auth, stats, work-types, team, and jobs full flow. Login lockout kicks in after 5 wrong attempts per IP+email for 15 min - be aware when re-running negative auth tests rapidly.
